| description = The weakest of the gnolls. Aggressive. For monks looking to do the White Headband Quest, there are two spawns in [[North Qeynos]] at 1255, 922 and 1177, -260. The gnoll pup at 1177, -260 shares a place holder timer with Nixx Darkpaw, and if the pup doesn't spawn Nixx will spawn at 1210, 481 instead (and shout an announcement.) They will spawn at these locations and begin wandering around the zone and have a 6 minute 40 second spawn time. (Timed on 4/23/2020 on Green) Two more spawn near the exit to [[Qeynos Hills]] inside [[Blackburrow]] and these are static spawns but they are on a much longer, 22 minute respawn. The scalps are a less than common drop, so be prepared for a tedious grind.
